notes.title: Mythrel v0.6.0
notes.content:
[b]Mythrel's Exciting New Update![/b]

Attention Mythrel fans! A thrilling update is here, taking your gaming experience to new heights. Packed with cool new features and major enhancements, this update is all about making your gameplay more engaging and challenging than ever.

[b]'Nix': A New Solo Challenge Awaits[/b]

Welcome 'Nix' - she's the starting point of your solo adventures, offering a gameplay experience that's both friendly for beginners and progressively challenging as you grow. Each game with Nix is an opportunity to explore, learn, and improve your strategies and deck building skills.

Currently in the early stages of development and available in open beta, Nix is the perfect companion for players to practice and evolve. She may start simple, but she's evolving, just like your skills. Dive into solo play, track your progress, and watch both you and Nix grow together in skill and complexity.

[b]New Multiplayer Features for More Realism[/b]

Get ready for our new multiplayer networking features. Now, see your opponent's cards come to life as they think about their moves. It makes each game feel a bit more real and interactive.

[b]Better Performance and Fewer Bugs[/b]

We're always working to make Mythrel smoother. With this update, expect fewer glitches and better game stability.

Jump into these awesome new updates and discover the enhanced world of Mythrel. Your strategic skills and adventurous spirit are about to be rewarded. Let's play!

notes.content:
[h1]Mythrel v0.5.8 Release Notes [/h1]

✨ Unprecedented Features & Groundbreaking Additions! ✨

 [h3]Audri, The Healer – Dragon Scale Promo![/h3] 

Dive into the Mythrel realms with Audri, The Healer, marking a significant moment as the[b] FIRST-ever digital card you can acquire using Dragon Scales![/b] 🐉

A beacon in our digital collection, Audri's debut not only adds enchantment to a deck but also paves the way for the future.


[h3] Introducing Player Plaque Images[/h3] 

Experience our BRAND NEW feature: [b]21 DISTINCT player plaque images to flex your profile[/b]! Make your Mythrel persona shine! 🌟

Plus: Every plaque sports your unique referral QR code for smooth sharing! Be the talk of the town!


[h3] Referral System: Dive Deeper & Score BIG![/h3] 

[b]Sharing is Rewarding! The Mythrel Referral System is here, and it's PACKED with goodies for both you and your friends.[/b]

Step 1: Share your unique referral code, link, or flaunt your player plaque.

Step 2: Once your friends taste victory with at least three wins in Gauntlet realm matches, both of you pocket a cool [b]100 Dragon Scales[/b]! 🐉

Step 3: The journey continues! When your friend reaches the grandeur of player level three, thanks to twenty wins in Origin/Gambit Realm Matches, you both bask in the glow of[b] three current set booster packs[/b]. 🎁

Share, play, and relish the endless rewards! Login to the Codex to start sharing! https://codex.mythrel.com

Set forth in newly balanced terrains with our updated Vortex and Gauntlet realm decks, updated for riveting gameplay.

[h3]Refinements & Fixes[/h3]

Your feedback is gold! We've swatted some bugs and sprinkled several upgrades for a fluid Mythrel experience.

📣 Dive into v0.5.8 and explore these electrifying features, as the lore and allure of Mythrel continue to evolve!

Pre-Order Second Edition Booster Boxes, Blister Packs, and Playmats at https://store.mythrel.com with more information at https://codex.mythrel.com/preorder

notes.title: Mythrel v0.5.4
notes.content:
We're excited to announce Mythrel version[b] 0.5.4[/b], packed with new features, improvements, and fixes to enhance your trading card game experience. Here's what's new:

[b]Gambit Realm Mode:[/b] Engage in high-stakes battles with other players! Wager Dragon Scales, 1st Edition Kickstarter ETR Booster Packs, and Second Edition Booster Packs and win Origin Wins, improve your ELO, and increase your Player Level.

[b]New Realm Backgrounds:[/b] We've added five new hand-painted realm backgrounds to immerse you in your in-realm matches. These will currently be presented at random.

[b]Second Edition Preorders Open:[/b] Exciting news for all collectors! The Second Edition is now available for preorder at https://codex.mythrel.com/preorder. With over 150 cards to collect, the set includes 18 Mythical Holo, 8 Exotic Holo, 40 Rares, 36 Commons, 34 Uncommons, and 14 Full Art Rares exclusive to the Second Edition of Mythrel.

[b]Backend Updates:[/b] We've made significant backend updates to decks in preparation for future deck codes and importing/exporting.

[b]Second Edition Card Updates: [/b]Many new cards were added to this update to Second Edition, including the new vicious Black Dragon, the elegant Royal Wyvern, and many others!

[b]NEW Chapter 12 of Lore: [/b]Read it at https://mythrel.com/lore

[b]Account Settings & 2FA:[/b] Enhanced security with updates to account settings and 2FA.

[b]Codex Updates:[/b] Visit our updated codex at https://codex.mythrel.com for the latest information on the game.

[b]Miscellaneous Improvements & Fixes:[/b] As part of our continuous improvement process, this update also includes several other minor fixes and enhancements.

Enjoy the talents of prestigious artists such as Scott Murphy, Lius Lasahido, and Phil Stone, as well as AAA art studios like Polar Engine and Sonderflex in our Second Edition. Preorders will remain open according to demand. Second Edition will remain in early access while preorders are enabled for any final adjustments that will be made.

We hope you enjoy the latest update as much as we enjoyed making it for you! THANK YOU again for all of your feedback as always!

notes.title: Mythrel v0.5.3
notes.content:
[h1][b]Mythrel v0.5.3 Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

Hello, Mythrelians! We've have been hard at work and we're excited to announce the latest changes and improvements in version 0.5.3. Here's what's new in this update:

[b]14 New Second Edition Full Art Rare Cards: [/b]We've introduced a new batch of full art rare cards into the mix. Enhance your decks with these beautifully crafted cards and let the battles commence! These are of regular "Rare" rarity but a beautiful "full art" version of the card.

[b]2 New Second Edition Rare Cards: [/b]Apart from the full art rares, we've also added 2 new rare cards and many other of various rarities! More options for strategic play and deck building! (Expect more Second Edition cards to change before finalization, thank you for your feedback!).

[b]Codex Card Enhancements:[/b] The Codex will now have Mythicals and Exotics with a rainbow effect in 2D to better establish card rarity and type.

[b]Card Sleeve Options:[/b] Personalize your game experience with over [b]17 new card sleeve designs[/b] available in the Dragon Scale Bazaar! You can also use your card sleeves during in-realm matches. Show off your personal style in every match! You can spend Dragon Scales on Card Sleeves to unlock permanently for your account, more will be coming!

[b]Bug Fixes & Improvements:[/b]
We've squashed some bugs and made a handful of under-the-hood improvements to enhance game performance and stability.

We'd like to take this opportunity to thank all our players for their continuous support and feedback. As always, we're listening to your suggestions and continuously working to improve your experience in the realm of Mythrel.

Physical product for 1st Edition Kickstarter is shipping this week! Be sure to stream your box openings or join another one and tag us in socials! Pre-Orders will be going live soon for Second Edition!

notes.title: Mythrel v0.5.2
notes.content:
[h1][b]Mythrel v0.5.2 Release Notes[/b][/h1]

Greetings, Mythrel fans! We're excited to bring you the latest update, v0.5.2, that adds a bunch of new features and improvements to enhance your trading card game experience!

[b]New Market Feature: [/b]Now, you can easily list your cards for sale, purchase available listings, or cancel your own on the market at https://codex.mythrel.com. It's a great way to expand your collection and discover new cards!

[b]Performance Improvements: [/b]We've done a significant number of backend updates to improve game performance. These enhancements should make your gameplay smoother and more enjoyable.

[b]Card Updates and Additions:[/b] As we move toward the release of the Second Edition, we've [b]updated over 13 cards[/b] for Second Edition early access. But that's not all, we've added two new game balancing cards, the "Revenant Ruler" and "Willow of Withering" - both meticulously designed by the renowned MTG artist [b]Scott Murphy[/b]!

[b]Further Improvements and Future Plans:[/b] As always, we've made a slew of miscellaneous improvements and we have many more in the pipeline. Stay tuned for even more new cards, updated artwork, and features coming in the Second Edition!

As we continue to evolve Mythrel, we welcome and appreciate your feedback. Thank you for your ongoing support, and we can't wait for you to enjoy these latest improvements!

See you in the realms!

[b]Card Balances and Updates[/b]
We've rebalanced and updated numerous cards from our Second Edition. Both stats and artwork updates have been implemented, so make sure to check them out in your collections:

[b]Hide/Show Chat in-realm matches:[/b] We understand that sometimes, you need a distraction-free game. Now you have the option to hide or show chat during in-realm matches. The choice is yours!

notes.title: Mythrel v0.4.8 Second Edition
notes.content:
We're thrilled to unveil our new update - Mythrel: Enter The Realm Second Edition. This exciting update introduces a plethora of new cards and an expanded meta, providing a refreshing gameplay experience and opening up a multitude of new strategies for players. As we're still refining this edition, please note that these cards are part of an Early Access release and may undergo tweaks and adjustments before the physical product pre-orders commence.

[i][b]Second Edition: Early Access Preview[/b][/i]

[b]Engage with the game like never before with over 18 Mythical cards, 8 Exotics, 38 Rares, 36 Uncommons, and 36 Commons. Enjoy the diversity of more than 47 cards featuring brand-new artwork. All the cards introduced in this edition bear the Second Edition stamp and carry the set ID: SND-xxx.[/b]

As we're still perfecting the Second Edition, we welcome your feedback and look forward to making this the best edition yet. All Second Edition cards are subject to changes until pre-orders go live for print production.

[b]Improved Gameplay Experience[/b]

[i]This update also brings a host of improvements and fixes:[/i]

[b]Opponent's Mana Counter: [/b]We've rectified the issue with the mana counter to display the opponent's mana count correctly.

[b]In-Realm UI:[/b] The revised In-Realm UI now accurately reflects your current mana count.

[b]Species Frames:[/b] Enjoy the vibrant, revamped frames for the in-play species (creatures).

[b]Set Symbols:[/b] We've added set symbols to cards in-play for better visibility and understanding.

[b]Discord Player Market Bot: [/b]Now featuring card images for a more immersive trading experience.

[b]Drop Card Here Visual Cue: [/b]We've added a new visual aid to show players where to "drop" cards for play.

[b]Codex Updates:[/b] Access the latest patch notes and improved card visuals within the Codex.

[b]Improved Deck Manipulation on Mobile:[/b] We've improved the deck dragging/scrolling feature on mobile. Simply hold down for ~4 seconds to rearrange your deck list.

[b]Market Improvements:[/b] Now includes set id of cards along with Discord notifications for listings and sales. Second Edition Booster Packs (SND) are now also available in the market.

[b]Vortex and Gauntlet Deck Updates:[/b] We've removed weak decks and made updates. Expect more refinements in future updates.

[b]ELO Rating Updates:[/b] We've updated ELO ratings to use a KFactor of 16 if greater than 1500 ELO. This change will make ELO ratings less sensitive at higher rankings.

[b]Deck Builder Fix:[/b] The deck builder will now correctly navigate to page 1 when executing a search.

[b]Rules Changes:[/b] "Within Reason" is now limited only to 2x copies per deck and the new card "Elysia's Drake" is limited to 2x copies per deck only Mythical exception. You can only have the max copies of any card based on their name, so if a cards copy limit is 4 you can have e.g. 2x from 1st Edition of the same name and 2x from Second Edition as the same name.

Dive in and explore the realm of possibilities that this update has to offer. Stay tuned for more exciting updates as we continue to improve Mythrel.

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Mythrel v0.4.7
notes.content:
Mythrel v0.4.7 Release Notes

We are excited to announce the latest update for Mythrel, the Trading Card Game. In this version, we have focused on enhancing the overall user experience and addressing various issues reported by our dedicated community. Here are the key highlights of this release:

[b]Improved Interface and Text Updates:[/b]
We have implemented several enhancements to the interface, resulting in a more polished and visually appealing experience.
Various text updates have been made throughout the game to ensure clarity and consistency.

[b]Spell Card Double Play Prevention:[/b]
We have fixed an issue where players were able to unintentionally double click or play spell cards multiple times in quick succession. This fix ensures a fair and balanced gameplay experience for all players.

[b]Realm Chat Display Fix:[/b]
We have resolved an issue that caused realm chat messages to display chats from other realms.
Now, you can fully engage with your realm community without any interference.

[b]Vortex/Gauntlet Deck Fix:[/b]
Previously, there were decks with more than one life cost card in Vortex/Gauntlet deck configurations. This issue has been rectified, ensuring accurate gameplay mechanics.

[b]Card Drawing and Disconnection Issue Fix:[/b]
We have addressed a problem where players were experiencing disconnections from the realm while drawing more cards than available in their decks. This fix ensures uninterrupted gameplay sessions.

[b]Card Transfer Fix:[/b]
We have resolved an issue related to card transfers, ensuring smooth and reliable card trading between players.

[b]Private Card Collections:[/b]
Introducing a highly requested feature, you can now create private collections within the Mythrel Codex. Enjoy the freedom of organizing your cards in a confidential and secure manner.

[b]Battlerealm Spell and Species Limit Fix:[/b]
We have fixed a limitation where players were unable to play spells after playing more than six species in the Battlerealm. Now, you can fully enjoy the game!

[b]Improved Realm Joining and Creation:[/b]
We have streamlined the process of joining realms and creating new realms by introducing convenient popup confirmations.

[b]Deck List Drag Feature:[/b]
We are thrilled to introduce the deck list drag feature. You can now easily rearrange your deck by dragging a card, instantly moving it to the top of your deck list. Your deck art will always be showcased as the first card in your deck list.

[b]New Realm Background Art:[/b]
To enhance the immersive atmosphere of Mythrel, we have introduced captivating new realm background artwork. Immerse yourself in the rich and visually stunning realms of the game.

[b]UI Fixes and Updates:[/b]
We have diligently worked on fixing and updating various aspects of the user interface (UI), ensuring a smoother and more intuitive gameplay experience.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback as we strive to make Mythrel the best Trading Card Game in the world. Enjoy the latest update and dive into the thrilling world of Mythrel!

notes.title: Mythrel v0.4.6
notes.content:
[b]Mythrel v0.4.6[/b]

Greetings, brave Mythrelians! We're back with a fresh update designed to enhance your gaming adventure. In our quest for continuous improvement, we've tweaked, added, and fixed many things to give you a smoother and more balanced collectible trading card journey. Here's what's new in v0.4.6:

[b]An Optimized Piece of Play: [/b]To keep the game dynamic and the adrenaline pumping, we've reworked the End Turn button to avoid any inadvertent clicks. 

[b]Improved Gameplay Balance: [/b]In the spirit of fairness and engaging gameplay, the second player will now draw an extra card upon the realm's start. Additionally, to keep the strategy intact, only one copy of Promo cards is allowed per deck. Our game rules have been updated to reflect these changes for the physical version of Mythrel also.

[b]Lobby Screen Tooltips:[/b] For our players seeking further clarity, we've added tooltips to the lobby screen for realm modes, offering real-time tips and advice.

[b]A More Social Gaming Experience: [/b]You asked, we listened! Say hello to our new Global Chat System. Now, you can strategize, socialize, and celebrate victories with fellow players in real-time in-realm and globally! (New Commands: "/clear", "/reportplayer <username>". "/mute <username> (Send again to unmute)", "/help", with many more coming!)

[b]Intuitive Card Highlighting:[/b] We've fixed the issue with cards not being highlighted when playing targeting spells or Dragon Egg, enhancing the game's visual appeal and clarity.

[b]Deck Builder Alignment: [/b]Your deck is your arsenal, and we've made sure it looks impeccable. We've realigned the card zooms on the deck builder for a better viewing experience.

[b]Gaze of Fear:[/b] The ability of Gaze of Fear has been corrected to properly affect species until your next turn, providing a strategic gameplay edge.

[b]Mobile Card Zooms Bug Fixes: [/b]We've squashed some bugs affecting mobile card zooms

[b]Upgraded Server & Improved Security:[/b] We've bolstered security measures and upgraded our server to ensure a safe and efficient gaming environment.

[b]Seamless Card Transferring:[/b] If you own more than four copies of a card, transferring them will no longer modify your decks. Keep your winning decks intact!

[b]Unhindered Avatar Display:[/b] Say goodbye to cards obstructing avatars in-realm! We've solved this issue, providing a clear, uncluttered view.

[i][u][b]ONLY ~8 DAYS LEFT TO PURCHASE 1st EDITION KICKSTARTER PRODUCT![/b][/u][/i]

Every update brings us one step closer to our vision of the ultimate collectible trading card game experience. As always we appreciate your feedback and patience while we continue to build! We can't wait to see you in the realm, strategizing, battling, and climbing to victory!

notes.title: Mythrel v0.4.4
notes.content:
A completely random player now kicks off the game, regardless of whether they created the realm or not.

You can now report players, bugs, and suggest new features directly from the game, thanks to the new "/reportplayer <username>" command while in-realm chat.

Enjoy the silence with the new "/mute" command. This feature allows you to mute other players via the in-realm chat.

Dragon Scale Bazaar now has a Deactivate button for avatar frames.

Revamped "Realm History" to load much quicker!

Moved some logic functions (including mana-related functions) to the server for smoother gameplay.
Fixed the two deck bug for Origin and Tranquil quick play

Enhanced the input while selecting a card: now, only one card can be selected at a time.

Solved a possible issue where the mana could exceed 10.

Resolved a bug with attacking and ending your turn too quickly, this resolved a multitude of bugs related to this. This should make gameplay overall much less "buggy".

Addressed a problem where times weren't displaying correctly for all regions. This should make the game more accessible for our international players.

Resolved an issue where password input was missing on Gauntlet realm creation.

Fixed a problem with the timer being interactable on the right of the realm screen.

Addressed an issue where joining realms and the realm list weren't functioning as expected.

We've made fixes to windowed "borderless" fullscreen mode on Windows for a smoother gaming experience.

Many other updates, bug fixes, and improvements have been made!

As always, we appreciate the feedback from our gaming community. You help us make Mythrel better with each update! Enjoy the game. See you in the realms!

notes.title: Mythrel v0.4.1
notes.content:
Daily Login Rewards: Players will now receive daily 24 hour login bonuses! Earn dragon scales equal to 3x the number of consecutive days you've logged in, up to one week! 7 Days!

Steam Achievements: A new Steam achievement has been introduced for players who accumulate at least 1000 dragon scales.

More Immersive Sounds: The audio experience in Mythrel is now even richer! We've added multiple new sound effects in the lobby, during battle preparation, and for dragon scale-related events.

Windowed Fullscreen Mode: Players now have more flexibility with their viewing options. Alongside the existing fullscreen and windowed resizable modes, we've introduced a windowed fullscreen mode.

Card Balancing: We've fixed the issue of decks containing multiple life-cost cards, including card set numbers ETR-109, ETR-115, and ETR-63. Look forward to a more balanced realm match for Vortex and Gauntlet realm modes in this update.

Dragon Scale Bazaar: You can now spend your Dragon Scales in the new Dragon Scale Bazaar, some new cosmetic items are available to show off to your friends (Avatar Frames), some Exotic frames are reserved for only the elite. These display within in-realm matches over your Origin Win Avatar Level Frame. There are many more new cosmetic items coming in future updates, stay tuned!

Vortex RealmPopup: The popup for Vortex realm matches has been fixed for smoother gameplay.

You can now purchase Dragon Scales again from the Digital Shop or earn them from Gauntlet realms.

Login Screen UI: We've enhanced the user interface of the login screen. Now, on all platforms including Steam, there is a visible cursor indicating the active input box.

Gwyn The White Dragon: The card name text has been adjusted for better formatting in-realm.

Card Dragging Mechanics: We've improved the user interaction with the cards. The issue with cards sticking to the cursor during dragging has been partially fixed. Now, cards will animate and return to their original hand positions, providing a more intuitive and playable experience. More to this will come in future updates!

Tons of other misc. updates, improvements, and bug fixes!

We hope you enjoy these updates and improvements to Mythrel. More updates will be coming as always, See you in the realms! :fire:

notes.title: Mythrel v0.4.0
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce the latest updates for Mythrel. Version 0.4.0 brings a wealth of new features, improvements, and enhancements to deepen your gaming experience.

[b]New Gauntlet Realm Mode[/b]
In our commitment to continuously provide fresh and exciting content, we've introduced a new realm mode, Gauntlet. Functionally similar to the well-received Vortex mode, Gauntlet presents a unique challenge with its random deck configurations and rewards of 1-4 Dragon Scales. Notably, this mode is accessible to new players free of charge for up to 10 matches (provided you lose each one), opening up the thrills of Mythrel to an even broader audience. New players still now start with 10 Dragon Scales.

[b]Dragon Scales Update[/b]
We've also revised the Dragon Scales system. These can now be earned through participating in the Gauntlet mode and are available for transferring between accounts. Please note that Dragon Scales can no longer currently be purchased through our in-game shop, but may be brought back if the community demands it. Instead, we're working to bring you new ways to earn and use them for cosmetic enhancements, such as avatar frames, card sleeves, backgrounds, and more.

[b]Deck Rules Modification, Meta Update[/b]
To encourage a diverse and dynamic meta, we've adjusted the rules around life cost cards. In this update, you may include [b]a maximum of one life cost card per deck[/b], inviting players to explore a broader range of cards and strategies.

[b]Bug Fixes and UI Improvements[/b]
This update includes several bug fixes and user interface updates to improve overall game performance and usability. We've streamlined various aspects of the game interface, aiming to provide a smoother, more immersive experience.

[b]Realm Display Enhancements[/b]
For better realm identification, we've updated the game to display the creator's username in the realm list. Furthermore, the realm mode is now visibly communicated in matches to keep players informed.

We appreciate your support and look forward to hearing your feedback on the latest improvements. As always, happy gaming! See you in the realms! :fire:

notes.title: Mythrel v0.3.9
notes.content:
We are excited to present the new updates for Mythrel v0.3.9. In this version, we have made several improvements and updates to enhance the gaming experience. Let's have a look at what's new:

[b]New Features[/b]

[u]Fullscreen Mode: [/u]Enjoy your battles in a completely immersive way with the newly added fullscreen mode.

[u]Mulligan Update:[/u] Now, you'll be notified when your opponent is mulliganing during realm matches. No more guessing!

[u]FREE Vortex Realms:[/u] We've decided to make Vortex Realms entirely free. Our Dragon Scales are being gradually phased out, and any purchased scales will be refunded. This is part of our endeavor to create a better implementation. For supporting the game, we encourage buying packs, which can be transferred to others at no cost.

[b]Improvements[/b]

[u]Realm Match Making:[/u] We've fine-tuned our realm match making backend to enhance your gaming experience.

[u]Networking Improvements:[/u] We've also made numerous networking improvements to ensure smoother gameplay.

[b]Changes[/b]

[u]Market Listing Limit:[/u] To maintain a balanced marketplace, we've capped the maximum number of live market listings per player to 5.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[u]Gamefeed Flicker Fix:[/u] We've solved the gamefeed flicker issue some users were facing.

[u]Miscellaneous Bug Fixes:[/u] Apart from these, we've also ironed out several other minor bugs to enhance your gameplay experience.

We hope you enjoy this update. As always, we're eager to hear your feedback and appreciate your support!

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Mythrel v0.3.8
notes.content:
[b]Mythrel v0.3.8[/b]

[i][b]New Features[/b][/i]

Added new audio cues to enhance gameplay: including a new sound for last 10 seconds in Realm Matches and losing scenarios.

Our first batch of Steam Achievements are now live! Four achievements have been added:
Enter The Realm: Make a Mythrel account!
Level 5: Reach level 5 (50 Origin Wins)
Level 10: Reach level 10 (100 Origin Wins)
Level 20: Reach level 20 (200 Origin Wins)

The current number of online users is now displayed in the Codex, amongst other new features rolling out slowly.

Game server refactoring: Memory usage has been optimized for better performance.

Dragon Scale Vortex Matches has been updated. Now, you will not be debited your Dragon Scales if there is a disconnection or a player leaves the game. You will still incur losses and lose dragon scales if you concede the match.

Current time is now displayed on game screens, helping you keep track of your gaming sessions.

You must now have purchased at least 10 booster packs to be able to transfer Dragon Scales.

Added new Help option after login for new players, with links to Game Rules, Discord, How To Play, and Lore.

Additional information now in Account Settings

[i][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/i]

Corrected a bug that caused the level display to show inaccurately in realm matches.

Resolved an issue causing the game feed to flicker, particularly when viewing the last card in the list.

Online users count has been updated to improved accuracy.

Fixed a bug in Codex login that occurred when entering an incorrect username.

Potential fix for in-game play of creatures getting stuck.

Backend improvements and booster pack algorithm improvements.

Deprecated/Removed Rankings screen in favor of the Mythrel Codex Rankings

Updated in-game Player Market to have a larger vertical scrollbar

Many other misc. bug fixes, typo fixes, and improvements


We hope you enjoy these improvements and fixes, there are many more on the way and we are actively listening to you the players. We appreciate all of your support and patience as Mythrel gets off the ground, please continue to share your feedback - it helps us make Mythrel better. Enjoy your gaming!

notes.title: Mythrel v0.3.7.1
notes.content:
Mythrel v0.3.7.1 Patch Notes

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

1. Deck Creation Bug for Tranquil/Origin/League Matches:

We have resolved an issue that was preventing users from creating Tranquil, Origin, and League matches with less than 2 decks. You should now be able to enter these match types regardless of the number of decks you have created.

2. Dragon's Nest Card Display Bug:

Some players were experiencing missing graphics or misnamed elements in the Dragon's Nest card display. We've investigated and resolved this issue, so you should now be able to see all the elements as they were intended.

3. Typo in Dragon Scales Transfer:

There was a typo in the warning message when transferring Dragon Scales, causing some confusion among players. We have corrected this text, making the transfer process clearer and smoother for everyone.

[b]New Features:[/b]

1. Warning for Vortex Realm Creation and Joining:

We've added a warning message that will alert players that creating or joining a Vortex Realm will consume 1 Dragon Scale. This is aimed at ensuring players make informed decisions when participating in Vortex Realm matches!

Many many more updates and improvements will be coming as time goes on! Join our community on the Discord to join the discussions!
